fields.name: filterLabel
fields.label: Filter Bar Label
fields.description: Label displayed above the category chips. Defaults to 'Filter articles:' when left blank.

fields.name: allLabel
fields.label: All Chip Label
fields.description: Label for the chip that shows all articles. Defaults to 'All' when left blank.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alt Text
fields.description: Accessible description of the image. Falls back to the card title when left blank.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Article Title
fields.description: Headline displayed on the card and used as the link text.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Excerpt
fields.description: Short summary shown beneath the title (2-3 sentences recommended).

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Single category tag used to filter this card. Must exactly match the category label on all cards in the same category.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Publication Date
fields.description: Human-readable date string (e.g. 'January 15, 2026') displayed at the bottom of the card.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Card Link
fields.description: Destination page or URL when the card title or image is clicked.
